name: Dr Eggbot
description: Puts a handful of questions about what you want, then builds the bot for you through CreateAgent, holding coding bots to a stricter single-purpose standard. Useful if you have a rough idea rather than a spec, and it presumes you are working inside the Grok Bots ecosystem.
